eightElements.title: The Time Cafe
eightElements.short: Pay strictly for the time you spend. Enjoy unlimited beverages & Wi-Fi without waiter pressure.
eightElements.details: No hurry, no need to keep ordering coffees just to hold a table. Relax, read, or catch up with peers in a comforting, unhurried sanctuary.

eightElements.title: Workspace & Coworking
eightElements.short: Thoughtfully designed for freelancers, remote engineers, and creative small teams.
eightElements.details: Ergonomic seating, surge-protected power plugs at every desk, quiet focus zones, and collaborative discussion tables.

eightElements.title: Creator Studio
eightElements.short: Dedicated creator playground for podcasts, photo shoots, and reels.
eightElements.details: Equipped with customizable backdrops, acoustic dampening, dynamic studio lighting, and high-speed upload connections.

eightElements.title: Event Spaces
eightElements.short: Host book launches, music gigs, poetry open mics, and art workshops.
eightElements.details: Versatile indoor and courtyard stages with complete AV support and co-marketing to thousands of Pune & Nagpur patrons.

eightElements.title: The Art Store
eightElements.short: A creative boutique marketplace where independent creators showcase and sell their creations.
eightElements.details: From handmade pottery, scented candles, and illustrated prints to stationery — 100% curated from indie artists.

eightElements.title: Curated Library
eightElements.short: Over 500+ curated volumes ranging from classic literature to design and entrepreneurship.
eightElements.details: Curated from the founder's personal collection and community book-swap donations. Cosy reading armchairs included.

eightElements.title: Maker Space
eightElements.short: A hands-on workshop equipped for pottery, clay modeling, prototyping, and DIY crafts.
eightElements.details: Featuring pottery wheels, sculpting tools, and raw materials. Regular weekend beginner workshops conducted.

eightElements.title: The Kitchen
eightElements.short: Gourmet, wholesome comfort food crafted fresh with premium ingredients.
eightElements.details: Artisanal sourdough toasts, hand-rolled pastas, wholesome bowls, and specialty desserts. Plus, BYO home-cooked meals are always welcome.

faqs.q: How exactly does the Time Cafe work?
faqs.a: When you walk into Mauji, scan the QR code at reception to check in. Your time counter starts in your web dashboard. While inside, enjoy unlimited artisanal coffees, teas, snacks, high-speed Wi-Fi, and library access. When leaving, hit check out and pay cashless via UPI or card for the exact duration spent (@ ₹210/hr).

faqs.q: Can I bring my own food (BYO)?
faqs.a: Yes! Mauji is a BYO cafe. You are encouraged to bring your mom's tiffin, homemade meals, or order food via food delivery apps to our table. We never penalize you for bringing your own food.

faqs.q: Is Wi-Fi and unlimited coffee really included in ₹210/hr?
faqs.a: Yes, 100% included! There are no hidden charges. Hot cappuccinos, pour-overs, iced teas, Wi-Fi, and power ports are all covered by your hourly time pass.

faqs.q: How can I book the podcast/shoot studio or event space?
faqs.a: You can book directly via our online booking engine on this website, or connect with our community team via WhatsApp/Phone at +91 8010632001 or email pune@maujicafe.com.

faqs.q: Do you offer monthly memberships for freelancers?
faqs.a: Yes! Our Monthly Pass starts at ₹10,000/month, giving you unlimited desk hours, free studio meeting credits, priority workshop tickets, and endless brews.
